bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
CID=$(docker ps --filter ancestor=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.ID}}' | head -1)
test -n "$CID" || exit 31
PROJECT=$(docker inspect "$CID" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}')
test "$PROJECT" = deploy || exit 32
OV=$(mktemp --suffix=.yaml); trap 'rm -f "$OV"' EXIT
printf 'services:\n  gaybbs:\n    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:posting-menu-fix-662522a\n' > "$OV"
set +e
OUT=$(docker compose -p "$PROJECT" -f "$P/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -f "$OV" run --rm --no-deps gaybbs node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/recolorPublishedPostingMenus.mjs --apply 2>&1)
STATUS=$?
set -e
SUMMARY=$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep '^POSTING_MENU_EDIT_SUMMARY ' | tail -1 || true)
test -n "$SUMMARY" || { echo POSTING_MENU_EDIT_SUMMARY_UNAVAILABLE; exit 33; }
gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body "GAYBBS_POSTING_MENU_APPLY_20261113 exit=$STATUS $SUMMARY" >/dev/null || exit 34
test "$STATUS" -eq 0 || exit 35
printf '%s' "$SUMMARY" | grep -q '"existing":80,"changed":80,"failed":0,"newMessages":0' || exit 36
echo POSTING_MENU_ALL_80_EXISTING_MESSAGES_EDITED
